name: HSBC South Yorkshire Group Data Centre (SYGDC) refurbishment
notes: Planning design/access statement (Barnsley app 2024/0687) identifies the existing HSBC SYGDC at Maple Road, Tankersley, operational since 1981, with refurbishment of a basement computer room. No MW disclosed.

developer: Barnsley Metropolitan Borough Council / Bull TCL
notes: Public reports and supplier case study describe Barnsley MBC opening a new data centre under the Bull TCL operation; Workspace case study refers to ~120 rack capacity. Legacy facility; no MW.

division: England - Bath and North East Somerset
name: University of Bath 4 East South data centre
notes: University location page states 4 East South houses IT services and a data centre; campus project blog described the GBP23m building and data-centre fit-out. No MW disclosed; campus/research facility.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Service Express Bedford data centre
notes: Colo-X listing describes the Service Express Bedford data centre at 243 Ampthill Road as a 600-rack / 2MVA facility. Site is in Bedford borough; the larger Quest Park campus (Ampthill Rd/Stewartby) is in Central Bedfordshire and is recorded under that division.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: TRE Global UK Twinwoods Business Park data centre
notes: Estates Gazette reports TRE Global UK won planning permission for a ~200,000 sq ft data centre at Twinwoods Business Park, Milton Ernest, north Bedford (Bedford borough). Paywall limits detail; MW not stated.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Blackburn with Darwen Council data centre
developer: Blackburn with Darwen Borough Council / Sudlows
notes: Sudlows/Capitoline case studies describe a high-performance Tier II council data centre in Blackburn: ~200 sq m computer room in a 500 sq m building, GBP1.5m project. No other facility-grade DC evidence found for the borough.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Peel Park 80MW data centre
notes: Elite UK REIT (SGX) announced planning consent for a major Peel Park data centre near Blackpool; DCD reports an 80MW centre on a 20-acre plot with power secured (60MVA, looking to raise to 120MVA); Place North West notes consent for a 240,000 sq ft co-location facility.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Silicon Sands first data centre, Blackpool Airport Enterprise Zone
developer: Blackpool Council / HOCHTIEF Data Centre Partner UK
notes: Blackpool Council-backed 6MW first data centre at the Airport Enterprise Zone (Squires Gate Lane); DCD reports officers recommended planning permission; HOCHTIEF appointed for the ~GBP250m build; SPEN 32MVA primary substation under construction to serve the zone. Wider Silicon Sands masterplan is an enterprise-zone designation, not counted as a separate facility.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Intercity Bolton data centre
notes: Intercity states its Tier 3 data centres are in Birmingham and Bolton; DataCenterMap lists Intercity Bolton at Hallmark House, Paragon Business Park, BL6 6HG. Capacity not stated.

name: The Babbage Centre, Runcorn
notes: Principal acquired Getronics' Halton/Runcorn data centre at the ~45,000 sq ft Babbage Centre (The Heath Business & Technical Park, WA7 4QX); DCD reports ~2,800 sq m data-centre space; PeeringDB confirms the facility. Operational colocation.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Hartree Centre / Daresbury supercomputing data centre
developer: Science and Technology Facilities Council (STFC) / Hartree Centre
notes: Hartree/STFC built a new GBP30m data centre/supercomputing centre at Sci-Tech Daresbury (Halton); DCD reports the 24.41 petaflops Mary Coombs AI supercomputer deployed there in 2025. Research-grade HPC facility.

name: Co-op Rochdale data centre upgrades
notes: Sudlows case studies describe Co-op's Greater Manchester data centres including Rochdale; the 2010 Rochdale work added a second Tier II data hall, 16 cabinets and a 1MW site power upgrade. Legacy enterprise facility.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Rochdale Council Data Centre Refresh
notes: Council decision records approval of a strategic refresh of Rochdale Council's on-premise primary data centre (Number One Riverside) and secondary centre before end-of-life April 2026. Council IT facility, no MW.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Hanson Street Middleton modular data centre
notes: Rochdale planning application PL/2026/0034: change of use of land west of Hanson Street, Middleton, to a modular data centre (four prefabricated modular units, chillers, transformers, security fencing); valid but no decision recorded in source.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Kao Data Greater Manchester / Kenwood Point data centre
notes: 40MW, GBP350m facility at Kenwood Point, Reddish, Stockport; planning permission granted 27 March 2024 (Stockport Council); construction began with demolition on the former industrial site and is expected operational by late 2026 per Kao/Stockport Council and World Construction Network.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: AWS Burderop Hospital / Brimble Hill data centre
notes: Swindon Borough Council approved a four-hall data centre on the former HP Burderop Hospital site (Chiseldon, Swindon borough); DCD reported planning documents identified Amazon Data Services/AWS and 27MW capacity.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: nLighten Swindon data centre upgrade
notes: Swindon Borough Council reported nLighten planned up to GBP10m investment in its South Marston Industrial Estate data centre for upgrades/expansion; nLighten lists the Swindon edge location with 19,300 kW power.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Proximity Edge 7 Swindon data centre
notes: Proximity acquired the former Capgemini Merlin facility in 2021; Colo-X describes the operational South Marston site as 7MW / ~2,000 racks, Tier III-standard design.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Nationwide Swindon Technology Centre server-farm expansion
notes: Nationwide applied to Swindon Borough Council (Nov 2023) to expand its Hillmead Drive server farm by converting delivery bays to plant areas and adding roof plant. Enterprise server-farm expansion; no MW.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Ashton Old Baths commercial data centre
notes: Phase two of Ashton Old Baths (Ashton-under-Lyne) completed 2021 included Tameside's first commercial data centre hosting council/NHS/public-sector systems with business hosting available.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Google Thurrock Data Centre / former Arena Essex campus
notes: Hybrid planning application 25/00573/OUT submitted June 2025 by Global Infrastructure UK (Google) for a data centre campus on the former Arena Essex site, Purfleet-on-Thames (south of M25/A13); project website confirms Google ownership/operation if consented. Capacity not yet disclosed.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

developer: GVA Connect / Gateway Data Centre site promoters
notes: DCD reported the Gateway Data Centre site in West Thurrock held planning permissions for 86,000 sq ft white space / 210,000 sq ft GIA with up to 50MVA power potentially available; MW not stated. Older scheme; re-verify current status before use.

developer: Wrightington, Wigan and Leigh NHS Foundation Trust / Capitoline

name: BE Bournemouth data centre
notes: The BE Company facility at County Gates House, Poole (BCP Council area) described in the April 2025 spec sheet as operational since 2009, 0.6MW total capacity / up to 400kW IT load, 3MW scaling potential.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: AWS LHR-Bracknell / former HP Amen Corner data centre
notes: Plans filed 2021 for a four-data-hall facility on the former HP site at Cain Road/Amen Corner (Bracknell Forest app 21/00239/FUL); Baxtel reports AWS operates the completed Bracknell facility (~27MW IT load). EdgeCore is also listed at Amen Corner (directory); Bracknell Amen Corner SPD confirms the site's data-centre allocation.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Keppel DC REIT London Data Centre / Waterside House
notes: Keppel DC REIT acquired Waterside House, Bracknell town centre for GBP57m (renamed London Data Centre), fully leased to Vodafone through 2039, refurbished 2015. Capacity not disclosed.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Deep Green Bradford heat-reuse data centre
notes: Planning approval secured (official Deep Green + BBC) for a 5.6MW heat-reusing data centre on Listerhills Road, Bradford, adjacent to the Thornton Road Energy Centre, supplying waste heat to the Bradford Energy Network.
